result.reason: The clause moves toward the preferred position by assigning Deliverables to Customer and preserving Vendor Technology, but it does not grant Customer the required perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables, does not address Customer Data, and conditions ownership on unspecified “payment.” “Upon payment” also conflicts with the present-assignment wording. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions, and its proposed fallback is not included in the clause.
